claims.text: Many reviewers praise the close, quality shave and consider it among the best Norelco shavers they've used.
The Jet Clean cleaning/charging station is widely criticized as poorly designed, unreliable, or unnecessary.
Some reviewers report durability and battery problems, including units failing to hold a charge.
Several reviewers note the shaver performs similarly to other Norelco models with little noticeable difference.
Some users find the shave uncomfortable or not close on certain areas like the neck, especially when dry.
